title: [FMLA 23] StadiaDist — Stadia Calculations (Distance)
formulas: D = K · s · cos² θ + C · cos θ

body.text: Calculator scroll name: StadiaDist. Surveying stadia horizontal distance.
Same reading s and θ, different combination of sin/cos, so you get distance along the ground instead of height.

body.caption: Same sight as the height formula, but the result is the horizontal distance D to the staff.

body.text: Primary inputs: K, s, C, θ.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 2, then 3 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Angle unit
body.text: Run in Deg. Typical internal-focus instruments use K = 100 and C = 0. The calculator labels the result S. Companion height formula is FMLA 22: H = Ks sinθ cosθ + C sinθ.
